correctness.rationale: For m≥3 over C and generic nonresonant parameters, the first m critical equations give f=sA(U)/S and t_i=−ν_i A(U)/(S L_i(U)); elimination of the last equation is exactly P_m=(Sb₀U+vA)G−UAΣν_i b_i G_i, degree m+1. Linear unit-coefficient eliminations identify critical schemes on the generic open locus, including degeneracy. The source Goertz–Sturmfels–Telen irreducibility and smooth Segre Hurwitz-degree theorems give primitive Λ_m as a factor of Disc_U(P_m) and bidegree (2m(m+1),2m). The coefficients of P_m have bidegree (m+1,1), so its nonzero discriminant has the same bidegree: ν_i=0 specializes to a product of generically distinct linear factors, proving nonzero. Thus the factor quotient is constant. The independent SymPy m=3 check confirmed degree four, nonzero discriminant and polynomial eliminant with correct endpoints. The proof, not the bounded m=3 arithmetic, establishes all m.
